title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1554: Assembled invincible (1)

section.p: “So strong!”
The Invincible groaned in discomfort. Su Yu might have killed Immortal King Heng before, but that was mostly a sneak attack. But this time, Su Yu was facing him head-on.
A different Invincible shouted, “He only has brute force. Just watch out for his spatial dao and focus on his past and future.”
With that, the Invincible facing Su Yu understood what to do.

Su Yu’s vision blurred as a River of Time flowed toward him again. The river swirled around him, causing his vision to blur again, giving him a sensation that he had returned to a moment ago. This was a much trickier opponent than Blood Fire.

At the time, Blood Fire was already too injured to maintain his control over the power of time. Fortunately, Su Yu had a way to deal with this. His opponent was trying to kill his past from a moment ago. That wouldn’t kill him for real so easily, but it would still injure him.

With a roar, he activated the slow character. A rumble rang out as cracks appeared on the slow character while the River of Time slowed slightly. That minute change was enough to bring the attack back to the present, allowing Su Yu to throw another punch.
The Invincible’s expression changed drastically as he hurriedly retreated with his River of Time.

Su Yu’s punch missed. He followed with a kick, aimed at the river. With his high level of mastery over the Time technique, a kick from him was able to stop time itself for a short moment. Elsewhere, Silk Destroying King sensed something and looked in Su Yu’s direction. His eyes flickered at what he saw.
“What an impressive kid.”

The kid had used brute force to defeat time itself. Defeating time with brute force was nearly impossible. Only Su Yu, with his excessive physical strength and weak control over the power of laws, was capable of performing this impossible feat.
The kick landed on the river, creating a massive explosion. Once again, the Invincible was pushed back. Blood started seeping out of his mouth. He was greatly shaken.

As a fifth-degree Eternal, he was actually weaker than Su Yu in physical strength. Even when he was trying to utilize the power of laws, he was repeatedly interrupted by Su Yu and suffered a backlash as a result.
“Su Yu, you are indeed a monster!”

Su Yu did not give chase since it would be too hard for him to match an Invincible in speed. In any case, he did not want to move away since he had successfully determined Xing Yue’s location. A tunnel connecting straight to her could be opened here.
Dozens of death sovereigns were having a meeting down there. Su Yu was confident these Invincibles would love that.
Su Yu looked around and indifferently said, “Is that all? Take all you have out. Do you think a single Eternal is enough to kill me?”
Fighting fairly?

No! That was not something the myriad races would do. Since they were so determined to kill him, why would they fight with equal numbers when they had the numerical advantage? Sure enough, three more Invincibles walked out of thin air. At this point, all the experts around Su Yu were already occupied.
The three Invincibles started approaching Su Yu with solemn expressions.
Su Yu. What a remarkable person.

He had only been cultivating for a short time yet he had grown enough to fight Invincibles. How long had it been since humanity produced a monster like this? Even the human king of the previous epoch was not as terrifying when he was this young. Su Yu must die!
The three stopped beside the Invincible, who was fighting Su Yu previously. Without saying anything to each other, they acted in unison and sent four Rivers of Time toward Su Yu.

Once again, deafening rumbles rang out. Punch after punch was thrown by Su Yu. He was displaying an incredible amount of strength. On his forehead, the Heaven Gate started emerging. He was about to use his full strength. He was about to kill.
Opening the Heaven Gate to kill Invincibles.
Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.
The pavilion Invincibles did not join the battle.
They were all gathering up.

Of the four departments, two spires, and two chambers, the Heaven Department head and Yellow Department head was absent. After Zhu Tianfang’s departure, a new head had yet to be appointed for the Yellow Department.

Including the Heavenly Overseer Marquis, nine Invincibles had gathered in the palace. This was an incredibly powerful faction. That was especially true since the Heavenly Overseer Marquis was an ancient past marquis. He was a genuine Daofuse from the ancient past with excellent combat strength.

All the Invincibles looked at the scholar, wondering about their choice here. A large number of experts from the various races had joined the battle. In fact, the number of Invincibles engaged in the current battle had surpassed one hundred. A large number of them were late-degree Eternals. This was a true fight to the death, unlike the previous conflict involving the human race where they were merely trying to stop the dao affirmations.
After all, the guardians were losing their minds, fighting with the intention to kill instead of holding back. One could easily die participating in such a battle.
“Pavilion Master…”
Heavenly Overseer Marquis remained silent. He continued staring at Su Yu. When he noticed the indistinct Heaven Gate on Su Yu’s forehead, his expression turned complicated.
How…similar.

Lord Culture King…was he really the Time Sage? Had Su Yu received Culture King’s Time Sage legacy? Or was the multiple character faction his main legacy? Regardless of the answer, it was very likely that Su Yu had received the legacy of Culture King. A true legacy.
Su Yu would be much scarier with Culture King’s full legacy. Would he grow into the next Culture King? The scholar continued observing the battle in silence.
An Invincible couldn’t hold his calm and asked again, “Pavilion Master, do we join the battle?”
After a while, the scholar replied calmly, “There is no rush. We wait before we decide.”

Did they think that this battle was the end? No. This was merely the start. Sure enough, the willpower of the various experts filled the area. They seemed to have reached a certain agreement as a Nether River started flowing out of the Nether Realm. Then, an ageless figure wearing an ash gray crown stepped out of the river.

He gazed at the depth of the sea in the old turtle’s direction. He was waiting for the old turtle to make a move. However, the old turtle remained still. Inside the ancient city, the old turtle looked like he was sleeping. He did not look like he was going to make a move. Just then, a plump soul devourer appeared near the Nether River.
“Yo! Nether guy, you stink!”
The Nether Pseudo Emperor looked at the plump soul devourer and asked indifferently, “Are you here to stop me?”
“No, not at all. I’m here to…eat you!”
The plump soul devourer opened his mouth. Instantly, the entire sky was replaced by a mouth.
“You stink! You will smell better after a few licks from me!”
“Soy Bun, the Culture King is dead. Are you still living in the past? Things have changed.”

A staff appeared in the Nether Pseudo Emperor’s hand. As he swept it toward Soy Bun, he said, “Your race should have ceased existing long ago. Do you really think we’re helpless against you? The ancient past is no more. We live in a new era.”
“Ah? You got the wrong person.”
Suddenly, an even larger mouth appeared behind the Nether Pseudo Emperor. A different voice rang out, “Soy Bun is here! Stinky, apologize!”

At that, the Nether Pseudo Emperor’s expression changed. At almost the same time, a sigh rang out as yet another figure appeared out of thin air. The newcomer said, “Senior Soy Bun, why must you do this?”
“Jiwu!”
Soy Bun hopped away and stared at the newcomer with wide eyes as he asked, “Jiwu, are you joining the fight as well? The two of you are too strong! We are not enough to defeat you both!”
Jiwu, the Divine Pseudo Emperor.

With a regretful tone, the Divine Pseudo Emperor said, “I don’t want to fight here, but I don’t have a reason to stay away from the fight. Su Yu must die to ensure the peace of the Myriad Realms. Soy Bun, you have lived through nine epochs. You have never helped the humans once. I have always believed that you have forgotten the past. Why have you been so active lately? The ancient past is no more. You should learn to stay your hand.”
Both Soy Bun and his wife had appeared.
Unfortunately, two ancient Pseudo Emperors had appeared as well.
Both Pseudo Emperors were incredibly strong. The Divine Pseudo Emperor was stronger than even the Devil Pseudo Emperor while the Nether Pseudo Emperor was as strong as the Devil Pseudo Emperor.
The two soul devourers might be strong, but they were not strong enough to handle two such opponents.
The big furball asked in confusion, “Did I do anything with my hands? My hands are still in here. I only used my mouth!”
The Divine Pseudo Emperor sighed and said, “You know what I’m talking about.”
Soy Bun thought for a bit and said, “Our young lad is with him. Killing him will kill our young lad as well.”

“Is your race still the same? Picking someone to adhere to? Soy Bun, you have attached yourself to the Culture King for many years. But even with his incredible strength, he died. Is Su Yu better than the Culture King?”
Soy Bun laughed and said, “I don’t know. Why don’t we wait and see?”
His mouth enlarged as he said with a wronged expression, “I didn’t use my hands earlier, but you accused me of using my hands! In that case, I’ll start using my hands!”
Then, two arms shot out of his plump body and reached out toward the Divine Pseudo Emperor.

With a swirling River of Time around him, the Divine Pseudo Emperor evaded the attacks instead of attacking. He sighed repeatedly and said, “When the human race falls, the myriad races will enjoy peace. This has been happening again and again for a hundred thousand years. We are all tired of this. Everyone says that the divines and devils are warlike, but that’s because of the humans. Everyone says that the humans are frail and weak, but you don’t know what they did when they were at their peak. You don’t know how they used to sweep across the Myriad Realms and massacre the myriad races.”
“Yum!”

Soy Bun answered with a bite. He couldn’t be bothered to argue. And thus, a battle erupted between the four Daofuses. Above them, scenes from the past and future flickered past repeatedly as they fought.

They were not only fighting in the present. Their past and future were also fighting each other. The way they fought was different from how the tri-body cultivators fought. As they fought, the four Rivers of Time slowly merged into one. On the river, thousands upon thousands of them fought each other.
Their fight was on an entirely different level.

When a Soy Bun consumed a Divine Pseudo Emperor, a scene above them would shatter. A short while later, the present Soy Bun successfully swallowed the Divine Pseudo Emperor. But a different Divine Pseudo Emperor cut a way out of Soy Bun’s body. Noticing that, the present Soy Bun hurriedly spat the Divine Pseudo Emperor out.
Such a battle caused numerous people to gasp in amazement.
Devil Realm.
The Devil Pseudo Emperor’s eyes flickered as he observed the battle.
This was a battle between four ancient existences.

Compared to them, the Devil Pseudo Emperor was merely a young man. He had only inherited the position after the death of the previous Devil Pseudo Emperor. Then again, his ability to achieve Daofuse at such a young age was proof of his incredible talent.

Very few individuals had achieved Daofuse during the past three epochs. And he was one of them. As for the rest, they were either dead or missing. Not a single Daofuse in existence was of the same age as him.
Beside him, a devil king sighed and said, “Emperor, none of them cultivates the Three Body Method.”

The Devil Pseudo Emperor said calmly, “I guessed so long ago. Most of these geezers walk a different path. There are advantages and disadvantages to each path so don’t be too discouraged. The three body path is weaker, but it has its advantages.”
The devil king nodded and asked, “What about Blood Fire?”
“If he’s dead, he’s dead. This is an era where death is unavoidable for everyone. It is only a matter of time.”

The Devil Pseudo Emperor stared into the distance and said, “Return. After losing a body, I have weakened slightly. With Blood Fire’s death, the devil race has been weakened as well. We need to reorganize the entire blood fire race. It is only natural for there to be no top devil experts in this battle. We will be abstaining from conflict for now.”
The devil king nodded and asked, “What about Mo Duona?”

“Him?” The Devil Pseudo Emperor stared in a certain direction, as though he was looking straight at Mo Duona. He said, “His luck is not as bountiful as Su Yu’s, but he’s still someone with plentiful luck. However, his life has been too smooth. Capture him back. Throw him into the Devil Sea. That old bastard there has been hating me for ten thousand years. Have Mo Duona inherit his legacy.”
“The Emperor is wise!”
The devil king nodded and vanished with a flicker. The Devil Pseudo Emperor continued observing the battle for a bit before moving his gaze toward Su Yu. After some time, his figure faded away.
